<a name="Shell"></a>
## func Shell

```go
func Shell(keymap keys.KeyMap, enterLabel, body string, extra ...keys.Binding) string
```

Shell renders the standard TUI frame. Callers pass the full extra bindings they want shown, in the order they want them shown.
